conditional.label: Valor
conditional.detail: Attacks grant 20 Move Speed for 2 seconds (halved for ranged champions).

conditional.label: Conversion
conditional.detail: Takedown participation grants 0.5% Omnivamp, up to 5% additional Omnivamp.

conditional.label: Now and Forever
conditional.detail: Above 50% Health: 5% bonus damage. Below 50% Health: 12% increased healing and shielding.

conditional.label: Drain
conditional.detail: Three attacks or abilities on the same champion slow them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

conditional.label: Practice Makes Perfect
conditional.detail: Attacks permanently grant Critical Rate, 0.2% per attack for ranged and 0.4% for melee, up to 25%.

conditional.label: Flurry
conditional.detail: Attacking a champion grants 25% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.

conditional.label: Sharpshooter
conditional.detail: The Energized attack deals 80 bonus magic damage and grants 35% bonus Attack Range, up to 150.

conditional.label: Magnification
conditional.detail: Attacks deal up to 10% bonus damage, reaching the maximum at 550 units away.

conditional.label: Arcane Aim
conditional.detail: A takedown within 3 seconds of your damage grants 100 Attack Range for 8 seconds.

conditional.label: Opening Barrage
conditional.detail: After your ultimate, your next 3 attacks crit for 80% of normal critical damage, or deal 15% bonus true damage if they would already crit.

conditional.label: Lifeline
conditional.detail: Dropping below 35% Health shields you for 300-550 (350-650 melee) for 3 seconds. (70s cooldown)

conditional.label: Bolt
conditional.detail: The Energized attack deals 120 bonus magic damage and grants 45% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.

conditional.label: Electrospark
conditional.detail: The Energized attack chains to 3-6 targets for 60 magic damage each, 90 against minions and monsters, and applies on-hit effects to them.
